articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: Indeed's best jobs for 2026: Where to find mobility & security. Indeed created a methodology for finding the "best jobs for 2026," including specific criteria for positions that offer long-term mobility and job security. Indeed Director of Economic Research Laura Ullrich — one of the authors of this list — lays out the sectors and industries where these jobs are most apparent and the amount of training necessary for these types of jobs.
